study type: Retrospective comparative study using registry data
cohort: The cohort consisted of women aged 20-45 years with SARS-CoV-2 infection who were admitted to an intensive care unit in Sweden, categorized as either pregnant/postpartum or non-pregnant.
finding: The risk of being admitted to ICU may be higher in pregnant and postpartum women with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 in Sweden, compared with non-pregnant women of similar age.
cross-section timing: Data on ICU admissions were analyzed from March 19 to April 20, 2020.
